messages.subject: Scatter plots of Genotypes vs Phenotype
parts:
Hello Karl,

Thanks so much for this resource! I have a naive question: is there a function or a guide to make plots of genotype vs phenotype with the linear regression model? Like this? https://smcclatchy.github.io/mapping/fig/model-equation.png

It won't be difficult for me to implement it myself but I don't want to reinvent the wheel.

Thanks!

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl2-disc] Scatter plots of Genotypes vs Phenotype
parts:
You can create a plot of phenotypes vs genotypes with plot_pxg().
You could add annotations with lines(), segments(), and text().

karl
